name: mai-mobile
description: mAI Mobile – WebView Capacitor pour https://mai-officiel.vercel.app (Android/iOS non signés)

scripts.build:android: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.build:android:release: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.file="" -Pandroid.injected.signing.store.password="" -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.alias="" -Pandroid.injected.signing.key.password=""
scripts.build:ios: npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath ios/App/build/App.xcarchive CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" archive || echo "ios build requires macOS"
